At the [[1996 Summer Olympics]] in [[Atlanta]], four tennis events (two for men and two for women) were contested. For the first time since the [[Tennis at the 1924 Summer Olympics|1924 Olympics]], a [[third place playoff]] was held to decide who would be awarded the bronze medal in each event.
